scalars.scalar_value: Any combination equivalent to: graduation from high school and sufficient training and experience to demonstrate the knowledge and abilities listed above.

items.item_text: 01. Which statement below best describes the highest level of education you have completed? Options: Some High School | High school graduate, diploma or the equivalent (GED) | Some college (less than 60 units) | Associate degree or at least 60 semester units | Bachelor's degree | Master's degree | Professional degree | Doctorate degree

02. Please describe your training and/or work experience in grounds maintenance, landscaping, gardening, or related work. Include the names of employers, dates of employment, and specific duties performed. If you do not have relevant training or experience, indicate "N/A."
03. Do you possess a valid California driver's license? Options: Yes | No
Any combination equivalent to: graduation from high school and sufficient training and experience to demonstrate the knowledge and abilities listed above.
Performs a variety of grounds maintenance and gardening duties in the beautification of assigned grounds and landscaped areas.
Plants, prunes, trims, and waters landscape plantings, including trees, shrubs, hedges, ground cover, and flowers.
Maintains turf and landscaped areas by mowing, edging, aerating, watering, raking, weeding, and sweeping walkways; removes cuttings, leaves, and debris.
Prepares soil and applies fertilizers and soil amendments to maintain plant health.

Operates and maintains power-driven ground equipment, including mowers, edgers, blowers, trimmers, sweepers, tractors, skid loaders, forklifts, and chain saws, as well as District vehicles and standard gardening hand tools.
Inspects assigned grounds for safety hazards and reports concerns to appropriate staff; may assist with minor repairs as assigned.
Performs related duties as assigned.
Basic grounds maintenance procedures including mowing, edging, raking and weeding
Methods, equipment and materials used in gardening and groundskeeping work
Cultivating, fertilizing, watering and spraying of flowers, trees and shrubs
Herbicides and other chemicals used in grounds maintenance
Basic operation of irrigation systems, controllers and sprinkler components
Proper operation of heavy grounds equipment
Basic record-keeping techniques
Mow, edge, water, weed, fertilize, rake and cultivate lawns, flower beds, athletic fields and other landscaped areas.
Perform routine maintenance on grounds maintenance equipment.
Observe legal and defensive driving practices.
Apply specialized chemicals to control and eradicate weeds, insects and other pests.
Understand and follow oral and written instructions.
Model communications and interactions that respect and include all individuals and their languages, abilities, religions, and cultures.
Operate hand and power tools and other ground equipment used in grounds maintenance.
